place.note: This brahmadeya has links to pontiffs of the Ahobila mutt. Mādhvas, Śrīvaiṣṇavas and smārta lived there. It is also where Yajñāsvāmi Dīkṣita, the grandson of Tyāgarāja Dīkṣita, himself a direct descendant of Appayya Dīkṣita, attained samādhi.
There is only one Vaiṣṇava temple in the brahmadeya as it stands today: the Gangadhareswarar Temple.
